stem: You join a stream of transactions with a stream of fraud alerts on txn_id. An alert arrives within 1 hour of its transaction. What do you need so that the join state does not grow without limit?
choices: Cache the fraud-alert stream in memory
A watermark on both inputs, plus an event-time range condition in the join
Use complete output mode
Nothing; join state expires automatically after 24 hours
explanation_ja: ストリーム同士の結合では、両側のウォーターマークと、結合条件の時間の範囲がそろって初めて、古い状態を捨てられます。自動で消える期限はありません。

stem: Inside foreachBatch, a MERGE into account_last_txn fails with "multiple source rows matched" because one micro-batch has several transactions for the same account_id. What is the right fix?
choices: Increase spark.sql.shuffle.partitions
Switch the query to append output mode
Use trigger(availableNow=True)
Keep only the latest row per account_id in the micro-batch (for example with row_number) before the MERGE
explanation_ja: MERGE は1つのターゲット行に複数の元の行が当たるとエラーになります。マイクロバッチの中で account_id ごとに最新の1行だけ残して(row_number など)から MERGE します。W2 ハンズオンの手順と同じです。

stem: A team wants built-in data quality rules, automatic ordering of dependent tables, and checkpoints that are managed for them, with as little code as possible. What should they use?
choices: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines
Structured Streaming with hand-written checkpoint paths
A Lakeflow Jobs task that runs a batch notebook every minute
A SQL warehouse query scheduled every 5 minutes
explanation_ja: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines には expectations(品質ルール)、テーブル間の依存関係の自動解決、チェックポイントの自動管理があります。細かい制御が必要なときは Structured Streaming を使います。

stem: On its first run, an Auto Loader stream finds about 1 million existing files. You want each micro-batch to handle a limited amount of data. Which option should you set?
choices: spark.sql.shuffle.partitions
trigger(continuous="1 second")
cloudFiles.maxFilesPerTrigger
cloudFiles.schemaHints
explanation_ja: cloudFiles.maxFilesPerTrigger(または maxBytesPerTrigger)で、1回のマイクロバッチで読む量を制限できます。schemaHints は型の指定用です。

stem: In Unity Catalog, what is a governed tag?
choices: Any tag a table owner sets on their own table
A tag with an account-level policy that defines its allowed values and who can assign it
A key-value pair stored only in Delta table properties
Another name for a column comment
explanation_ja: governed tag は、アカウントレベルで決めた「使ってよい値」と「付けてよい人」のルールがあるタグです。ABAC のポリシーはこのタグを条件に使います。
